Case No. 1617 20082021

Date: August 12, 2021.

Approximate Time: 18:12 local time.

Weather: N/A.

Season: Winter.

Witnesses: V. N. V., 58 years old.

Description: The witness reported that at 18:12 (HL) on August 12, 2021, for 21 seconds, he saw and filmed an aerial anomaly from an undetermined location in the commune of Traiguén, in the province of Malleco, in the Araucanía Region.

The reported information described it as an object "the size of an airplane," of a "form"

"oval-shaped" and "metallic" color. The user indicated that this flew from south to north, to the east of Traiguén, "above and between the clouds," with a movement he considered slow. He then added: "It didn't make any noise, nor did it leave a trail like a plane; that day it was cold, around 13 degrees."

He concluded his testimony by stating (sic): "I was in the courtyard of a private home in the commune of Traiguén, I looked up and I was able to observe a metallic object that didn't make any noise moving slowly from south to north."

The sun was above the object and allowed the apparatus to be seen, which reflected its metallic fuselage. It was larger than a commercial airplane. Upon closer observation, I could confirm that it emitted a type of heat and had an oval shape. I have two videos of the same object.

In emails on August 22, 23, and 26, 2021, the witness was asked to provide the footage captured on that occasion and specify the location where they were.

Additionally, on September 6 and 9, 2021, a method was indicated to obtain more information.

Make it possible for us to receive free up to 2 GB per shipment, since the user
indicated that his video file exceeded the capabilities of the institutional mail
(cefaa@dgac.gob.cl). As of the writing of this report, no material was received
nor did the informant contact the Committee again.

In anticipation of receiving the requested information, an initial location was
defined located in the Plaza de Armas de Traiguén, corresponding to the
coordinates 38° 15’ 02’’ South Latitude and 72° 40’ 01’’ West Longitude.

As seen in Figure 1, Traiguén is located in the Central Depression and aligned along the north-south axis with the aerodromes of Puerto Montt, Osorno, and Freire.

Figure 2 illustrates its geographical position in relation to multiple air routes. Outside the UT104 aeroroute that crosses over the city, two additional airways stand out that channel flights from south to north: UQ810 and UQ802. The latter passes to the east and extends in a north-northeasterly direction.

Figure 1

Figure 2. Airways around the commune of Traiguén.

Due to the testimony, the air traffic that could be interpreted as a light moving away towards the northeast of Traiguén was analyzed.

As shown in Figure 3, at the declared time, either the SKU402 flight by Sky Airline or the LAN078 flight by LATAM Airlines could have been seen. Minutes later, the LAN062 flight could also have been observed.

Figure 3. Air traffic at 18:12 (HL) on August 12, 2021. Traiguén marked.

orange rectangle.
 Images: Although requested via five emails on August 22, 23, 26; and September 6 and 9, 2021, the user only provided the information reported in their report.

Conclusion: Based on the analysis of the testimony and geographic and air traffic studies, it was concluded that it is highly likely that the reported sighting corresponds to either LATAM Airlines' LAN078 flight between Balmaceda and Santiago, or Sky Airline's SKU 402 flight, or LAN's LAN062 flight.

LATAM that covered the route from Puerto Montt to Santiago.

The absence of any audiovisual media that allowed for the delimitation of the date and
aspect of the reported information did not permit greater accuracy in the study, so
it is classified as "Probably Explained", in accordance with the Technical
Instructive of CEFAA.
